v1.8.4b (20 September 2023) |feed_title = 🏴‍☠️ Unwavering Tides 🌊 |previous_update = [[v1.8.2|Vigilante Update]] |next_update = [[v1.8.5]] }} ==Description== '''v1.8.4''' is the fifty-eighth update to be released on Tower Defense Simulator, on the 5th of August 2023. It introduced the [[Pirate Crate]], a few balance changes and skin cost reductions. Oddly, the update version for this update is ''v1.8.4'', despite there being no ''v1.8.3'' update. This update was also given the name '''Unwavering Tides Update'''. This version encompassed three updates, the main v1.8.4 Update (released 5 August 2023) and two minor updates, the v1.8.4a (released 19 September 2023) and v1.8.4b (released 20 September 2023).
